description: Same policy as gated: a version is proposed only once it has been public for two days. Patch, digest and pin updates merge themselves once CI passes; the rest only open a pull request

packageRules.description: Kubernetes libraries and controller-runtime move as one release train

The trivy binary in the image has to stay on the minor of the Trivy server it talks to (ADR 0003), which trivy-operator in fleet-infra decides. A new minor only opens a pull request, to be merged together with the server's upgrade
The image in config/ names the branch, not a version; fleet-infra pins the version

The official ubuntu image is proposed without the two-day wait. Docker Hub gives a tag's last push as its release time, and the official ubuntu tags are pushed again every day or two, so a tag would rarely look two days old and its updates would hardly ever be proposed. No image here is built on ubuntu today; the rule is kept so that one added later does not fall into the same trap. Docker Hub names are matched as written, so each way of writing the image is listed. The pull request's checks still have to pass
